title: fix(runtime): the capabilityUnavailable 501 answers in the request's language
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8HnUewvapJYQ6bivYQ8GJZ)_

Fixes #37864
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvsF1zxzrxqnFoXdzX

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/spec` `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` gains `capability_unavailable_install`, `capability_unavailable_unshipped`, `capability_unavailable_ui`, `capability_unavailable_ai` and `capability_unavailable_search` in every locale; `@objectstack/runtime` `HttpDispatcherResult.response` gains the optional, never-written `faultLogMessage`
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 部署里缺少 AI、自动化、通知或界面服务时，用户在中文、日文、西班牙文界面里看到的「功能未实现」提示，现在用自己的语言说明该装什么；以前一律是英文。
- 属于「错误提示跟随用户语言」这条线，接着上一轮把其余未实现提示本地化的工作，把剩下最大的一组英文提示补齐。
- 英文原句、状态码、错误码一个字节都不变，接口发现文档和给运维看的故障日志仍是英文；如果某句译文不准，只是提示措辞问题，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/unavailable.ts`:
  - `capabilityUnavailable(deps, context, slot)` now renders through `catalogNotImplemented`. The `501` is in the request's top `Accept-Language` tag and carries `Vary: Accept-Language`.
  - The slot-to-key map lives here; there is no new spec export. `ui`, `ai` and `search` each have a key of their own. Every other slot reads `capability_unavailable_install` with `{{package}}` from `CORE_SERVICE_PROVIDER`, or `capability_unavailable_unshipped` with `{{slot}}`.
  - `capabilityUnavailableMessage(slot, locale?)` and `capabilityUnavailableMessageFor(context, slot)` give the same sentence as a string.
  - The docblock says why discovery stays English (seat ruling, option B on the claim). Discovery is a machine-read surface, and a host-level `/discovery` has no request to read a language from.
- The operator's fault log stays English (seat ruling at L1-a):
  - A declared capability absence is logged once per route per process (`logServerFault`), so a localized line would carry the first caller's language for the life of the process.
  - `capabilityUnavailable` sets the answer's `faultLogMessage` to the English.
  - `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`: `HttpDispatcherResult.response` gains the optional `faultLogMessage?: string`. Its jsdoc says it is never written to the wire.
  - `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` `sendResultBase` passes `faultLogMessage` to `logServerFault` when it is a string, and `body.error.message` otherwise.
  - `packages/types/src/server-fault-log.ts`: the docblock for the declared-absence family now says the wire is localized and the log line stays English.
- Call sites: the ten in `ai.ts` (1), `automation.ts` (2), `notifications.ts` (6) and `ui.ts` (1) pass the context they already hold.
- `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts`:
  - The custom endpoint's flow target answered the same English sentence (`serviceUnavailableMessage('automation')`) at its two `501`s.
  - Both now answer `automationUnavailableAnswer(ctx)`: the same localized sentence, with `Vary: Accept-Language`.
  - Taken here by seat ruling on the claim.
- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`:
  - Five keys in `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`. The English is byte-identical to `serviceUnavailableMessage(slot)`.
  - A catalog docblock paragraph for the family, including that the fault log does not follow the request.
  - N3: zh-CN says 「定制包」 in the three sentences that said 「定制软件包」 (four occurrences), the console's term. zh-CN `_ai` reads 「开源框架没有随附的实现」, the wording `_unshipped` uses.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts` (N1): `requestLocaleOf`'s jsdoc names its two direct callers, `catalog-activation.ts` for the noun and `capabilityUnavailableMessageFor`.
- Changeset `37864-capability-unavailable-languages.md`: `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/types`, each at patch.

## Tests
- `domain-501-language-37811.test.ts`, the shared harness for domain `501` language pins:
  - New describe `#37864 · 3`:
    - The English of every `CoreServiceName` slot, and of an unknown slot, equals `serviceUnavailableMessage(slot)`. This is the drift half.
    - The five keys are translated in every locale, with the English placeholders kept.
    - Every slot renders non-English text in each catalog locale.
    - `/ai`, `/automation`, `/notifications` and `/ui`, each with no service, answer 501 · `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` · the slot's sentence in en, ja-JP and zh-CN, with `Vary`. The plain request reads the discovery English.
    - N2: `/mcp/skill` with no MCP server answers `mcp_server_unavailable` in the request's language, with `Vary`.
  - N4: the source walk now blanks comments, string literals and template literals first. It flags every `501` written in code in a domain module (any call, any wrapper), not only a literal `deps.error(…, 501)`.
    - `unavailable.ts` leaves the builder set and is walked.
    - The walker's comment names its two limits: regex literals are not lexed, and only `src/domains/` is walked.
    - Four reasoned exemptions. Each is matched by the code before the site and must still match exactly one site:
      - `meta.ts` `deps.errorFromThrown(e, 501)`: the thrown error's own message.
      - `mcp.ts` `resumeDoorError(…, 501)`: stays English by design.
      - `permission-set-clone.ts` `{ statusCode: 501, messageKey }`.
      - `permission-set-clone.ts`: the read-back of that `statusCode`.
    - A walker self-check pins a parenthesis inside a string, `errorFromThrown`, a wrapper and a template hole. It also pins no hit in strings, comments, `5010` or `x.501`.
- `catalog-activation-door.test.ts` (N2, nouns):
  - The six activation types are read off the door's own shape refusal, and must equal the rows of the new describe.
  - Each type is flipped through the door with no ledger in en, ja-JP, zh-CN and es-ES. It must answer its `catalog_activation_noun_TYPE` in that language, with `Vary`, and write nothing.
- `endpoint-executor.test.ts`: the flow endpoint's two `501`s in ja-JP and zh-CN, plus the English with no header, with `Vary` on each.
- `declared-capability-absence-warn-once.test.ts`, describe `#37864 — a localized 501 still logs its English`:
  - A ja-JP request, then a plain request, to `GET /notifications` with no messaging service.
  - The wire answer is Japanese.
  - The one warn line names `Install @objectstack/service-messaging to enable`.
  - The body carries no `faultLogMessage`.
- The two edited executor and warn-once suites take a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` for `check:test-source-alias`.

## Acceptance notes
- The `501`s now carry `Vary: Accept-Language`. This is an added header, the same one the other domain `501`s have carried since PR #37845.
- Size vs `origin/main`: 16 files across three packages (runtime, spec, types), +547 / −74.
- Out of scope:
  - The `501`s outside `src/domains/` that stay fixed English.
  - The log language of the other #37845 `501`s.
  - The "any 501" wording in the walker's jsdoc.
  - The seat files these as a follow-up card.
- Readings at head 62006110 (`origin/main` 93fa9118 merged in at d80d5fc3; the branch merges with current main with no conflict, and GitHub reports `mergeable_state` clean):
  - CI: 58 success, 11 skipped, none failed or pending.
  - runtime:
    - `test`: `Test Files  655 passed (655)`, `Tests  12370 passed | 25 skipped`.
    - `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0.
  - types:
    - `build`: exit 0.
    - `test`: `Tests  963 passed (963)`.
    - `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0.
  - eslint on the changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
  - Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 94 on this diff):
    - 93 exit 0.
    - NOT MEASURED, exit 3 prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`.
    - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` went red once while a sibling run was rebuilding `plugin-approvals` dist, and passed on a re-run.
    - `check:test-source-alias` went red in CI at f80fc5de on the edited warn-once suite, and passed after the module-top import in 62006110.
  - Ablations run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutated the committed fix and was restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
    - `capabilityUnavailable` back to a direct `deps.error(…, 501)`: `Tests  5 failed | 47 passed (52)`.
    - The activation noun rendered in English for es-ES: `6 failed | 95 passed (101)`.
    - The endpoint's sentence read without the request: `2 failed | 51 passed (53)`.
    - `capabilityUnavailable` with `faultLogMessage: undefined`: `1 failed | 7 passed (8)`.
    - `sendResultBase` ignoring `faultLogMessage`: `1 failed | 7 passed (8)`.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/runtime/src/domains/unavailable.ts`: `SLOT_SENTENCE_KEY`, `capabilityUnavailableSentence` and the `faultLogMessage` it sets.
2. `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` `sendResultBase`: the log message choice.
3. `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: the five `capability_unavailable_*` keys in each locale.
4. `packages/runtime/src/domains/domain-501-language-37811.test.ts`: `codeOnly` and the exemption list.

Two-minute check:
1. Run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/domain-501-language-37811.test.ts src/declared-capability-absence-warn-once.test.ts`. It shows 52 and 8 passing.
2. On a host with no AI service, run `curl -H 'Accept-Language: zh-CN' HOST/api/v1/ai/models`. It answers the zh-CN sentence with `Vary: Accept-Language`, and the server's warn line stays English.
